digest.component_or_area: file-impact tri-state documentation across gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and author guide
propositions: Documentation for the tri-state file-impact scope (undeclared, paths, none) is missing or incomplete across the gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and packaged author guide.

FILE_IMPACT events replace all derived fields per target state: paths sets a non-empty list and clears the reason, none empties the list and sets a substantive reason, and undeclared clears both paths and reason.

The no-file-impact plan-review criterion is advisory (0.95 block threshold) and applies only when file_impact_scope equals none, checking plausibility, whether the reason explains the absence, and whether the plan names a repository edit.

A public CLI behavior test asserts rebar explain plan communicates the three states, the set-file-impact --none command, docs-only/test-only using paths, advisory review, and both why-no-repository-files-change and where-output-or-evidence-lives.
Documentation-only and test-only repository changes must declare paths scope, never none, since they still edit repository files.
Verification requires a green public behavior test plus a separate auditable semantic checklist rather than source-grep or snapshot tests coupled to text placement.
